**Compliant — no redline proposed.**

Section 11 (Transition Assistance and Data Return) satisfies the preferred TRANSITION position on every element:

- **Trigger** — 11.1 applies "Upon expiry or termination for any reason."
- **Assistance period** — up to six months, with knowledge transfer, export support, replacement-supplier cooperation and continued service at then-current scope and service levels.
- **Pricing** — at the rates in the expiring Order Form, i.e. better than the playbook's "then-current rates"; noted, not flagged.
- **Data return** — 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with relationships and metadata; the clock runs from *our* request, which leaves timing in our control.
- **Deletion certification** — 11.3 requires secure deletion after we confirm successful return, with written certification by an authorized officer and a protected, purpose-limited law-required retention copy.

The planner's specific concern is also answered: 11.2 expressly provides that "Vendor shall not withhold Customer Data because of a fee dispute," so data return is not gated on payment. Sections 10 and 15 are consistent (10.1 preserves our Customer Data rights through any agreed transition period; 16.3 routes Customer Data back to Sections 11 and 15).
